    🌱 Mara's Garden

    A digital garden — a slow, public, perpetually-unfinished collection of notes I keep for myself and occasionally tend in the open. Nothing here is a polished "blog post." The right way to read this is to wander.

    A garden is not a finished thing. It is a relationship.

    How this place is organized

    I sort notes by ripeness rather than topic. See On Tending a Digital Garden for why I work this way.

    🌰 Seedling — fleeting, half-formed 🌿 Budding — actively worked on 🌳 Evergreen — tended for years

    The throughline

    If there's one idea connecting all of this, it's that resilient systems and a resilient mind are built the same way: assume failure, embrace what you can't control, and design for graceful degradation. The clearest expression of that is The Dichotomy of Control, which I keep finding hiding inside engineering problems like Idempotency Is a Superpower.
